{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Filter out rows with biomarker_baseline == -999
df_filtered = df[df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Step 2: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the highest sample_seq
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates
df_dedup = df_filtered.sort_values(by=['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Confirm deduplication: original rows 755, after dedup: 
print(f"After filtering baseline -999: {len(df_filtered)} rows")
print(f"After deduplication: {len(df_dedup)} patients")

# Check if any patient_id appears more than once after dedup
assert len(df_dedup) == len(df_dedup['patient_id'].unique()), "Duplicate patient_id after deduplication"

# Check that we have 3 sites, not 4
print(f"Sites present: {sorted(df_dedup['site'].unique())}")

# Check arm assignment: non-randomised, so we must adjust for severity
print(f"Arm distribution:")
print(df_dedup['arm'].value_counts())

print(f"Severity distribution by arm:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_dedup['arm'], df_dedup['severity']))"}
